seo.title: Wedding venue FAQs — Rosewood Courtyard
seo.description: Answers on ceremonies, catering, curfew, accommodation, suppliers, accessibility and parking at Rosewood Courtyard, a walled-garden wedding venue near Bath.

props.heading: Questions, *answered*
props.body: Everything couples usually ask before booking. If your question isn’t here, call us on {{business.phone}} — a real person will pick up.

props.heading: Ceremonies, food and the day itself
props.subheading: The details that shape your wedding day.

items.question: Are you licensed for civil ceremonies?
items.answer: Yes. The Rose Courtyard, the Orangery and the Coach House are licensed for civil ceremonies and civil partnerships. The Lawn can host blessings and celebrant-led ceremonies.

items.question: Can we hold a religious ceremony here?
items.answer: Legal religious ceremonies must take place in a registered place of worship, but many couples marry at St Andrew’s in the village and join us for a blessing in the garden.

items.question: Do you have in-house catering?
items.answer: Yes, and only in-house. Our head chef cooks everything on site, with produce from the walled garden and growers within twenty miles. Dietary needs are handled with care.

items.question: What time do celebrations finish?
items.answer: Amplified music ends at 11pm and carriages are at 11.30pm, out of respect for our neighbours. Guests staying in the Coach House are welcome to continue quietly by the fire.

items.question: Can we choose our own suppliers?
items.answer: Of course — florists, photographers, musicians and stylists are all your choice. We will share a list of people who know the estate well if it helps.

items.question: How many weddings do you host each year?
items.answer: No more than ninety, and only one per day, so you will always have exclusive use of the estate.

props.heading: Getting here, staying over and the small print

items.question: Where exactly are you?
items.answer: In the Chew Valley, about 25 minutes from Bath Spa station and 30 minutes from Bristol Airport. Full directions arrive with your booking.

items.question: How many guests can stay overnight?
items.answer: Twenty-four, in eleven bedrooms above the Coach House. We can recommend four inns and hotels within ten minutes for everyone else.

items.question: Is there parking?
items.answer: Space for 80 cars on a gravel field behind the Coach House, with a lit path to the garden. Taxis can be pre-booked for 11.30pm.

items.question: Is the estate accessible?
items.answer: Paths are level throughout and every space is step-free at ground level. One Coach House bedroom is fully accessible.

items.question: What happens if it rains?
items.answer: Every outdoor ceremony has an indoor twin. We make the call with you at 10am on the day and the team resets in under an hour.

items.question: What are the payment terms?
items.answer: A 25% deposit secures your date, with the balance due eight weeks before. Payment plans are available, and dates can be moved once free of charge.

props.heading: Come and ask in *person*
props.subheading: A private viewing takes about an hour, with tea in the Orangery afterwards.
